description: Watchlivo Cloudflare WAF & Anti-Crawler Armor Ruleset

rules.name: Block / Challenge Datacenter Bots & Copyright Scrapers
rules.description: Challenges requests from major datacenter ASNs (AWS, Hetzner, OVH, DigitalOcean) and requests with low bot scores.

rules.name: Enforce No-Index & No-Archive on All HTTP Responses

headers.X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, noimageindex, nocache

rules.description: Edge-level response header transformation to ensure zero search engine indexing.

rules.name: Block Cross-Site Hotlinking on Stream & Catalog Endpoints
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/rave/resolve-catalog" or http.request.uri.path contains "/api/rave/stream") and (http.request.headers["sec-fetch-site"][0] eq "cross-site")
rules.description: Terminates cross-site unauthorized embedding and external API scraping before hitting the origin server.
